## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r q1}


m=c(-3,1,4)
S=matrix(c(1,-2,0,
           -2,5,0,
           0,0,2),nrow =3)
#a)
l=c(1/2,1/2,0)
k=c(0,0,1)
y_1=t(l)%*%S%*%k
ifelse(y_1==0,"independently distributed","not independently distributed")

#b)
l_1=c(1,-1,0)
k_1=c(1,1,0)
y_2=t(l_1)%*%S%*%k_1
ifelse(y_2==0,"independently distributed","not independently distributed")

#c)
l_2=c(0,1,0)
k_2=c(-5/2,1,-1)
y_3=l_2%*%S%*%k_2
ifelse(y_3==0,"independently distributed","not independently distributed")

# d)
A=matrix(c(1,1,0,
           3,-1,0),nrow=2)
B=matrix(c(1,0,0,
           1,-1,0,
           1,4,-1),nrow=3)
Y2=A%*%S%*%t(B)
ifelse(all(Y2==0),"independently distributed","not independently distributed")


```

# Solution for 2

```{r q2}
#| echo: false
m = as.vector(c(2,-3,1)) # mean vector (p = 3)
s = matrix(c(1,1,1,
             1,2,1,
             1,1,2), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)  # 3x3 covariance matrix

# Define transformation matrix A (e.g., A is 2 x 3)
A = matrix(c( 1,  0, -1,
              0,  1,  1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

# Compute and print theoretical mean and covariance of Y = AX
my = A %*% m
vcmy = A %*% s %*% t(A)
cat("Theoretical Mean of Y = AX:\n");print(my);
cat("\nTheoretical Covariance of Y = AX:\n");print(vcmy);

```

# Solution 3

```{r}
# Independence of transformed random variables
# Define two linear combinations: Y1 = a'X, Y2 = b'X
# Compute Cov(Y1, Y2) = a'Σb

m= c(0, 0, 0)
s = matrix(c( 2, 1, 0,
              1, 3, 0,
              0, 0, 1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
a=c(1,-1,0)
b = c(1, 1, 0)   #Only depends on first two variables
# Step 3:
cov_1=t(a) %*%s%*% b
cat("Cov(Y1, Y2) =",cov_1,"\n")


# Visualization through Simulation X and compute empirical correlation
set.seed(123)
n = 50
X = t(mvrnorm(n, m, s))
Y1 = as.matrix(a %*% X)
Y2 = as.matrix(b %*% X)
cor(Y1[1,],Y2[1,])
# Step 5: Plot to visualize relation
plot(Y1, Y2, pch = 20, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3),
     main = "Scatterplot of Y1 vs Y2",
     xlab = "Y1 = a'X", ylab="Y2=b'X")
```
